title: Womp Womp
blurb: A sad trombone, converted into speech and aimed directly at somebody's face. TikTok revived the phrase as the official response to complaints that will not be receiving sympathy — consequences arising from a person's own decisions, minor inconveniences presented as catastrophes, villains receiving precisely what they ordered. Two syllables, zero compassion, complete conversational closure. It is far crueller than the instrument it imitates, because a trombone is at least performed by somebody who has bothered to pick up an instrument. Use it sparingly, or do not.
origin: The spoken 'womp womp' dismissal, revived as a viral TikTok response.
